checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same woman at the kitchen table throughout
must.why: All frames show the same woman, kitchen and framing as the source.

must.item: Subtitles cover the complete spoken sentence without omissions or invented speech
must.why: The frame at 1 s shows her speaking with no subtitle, and 'Hi everyone!' never appears. The rest of the sentence is present.

must.item: Chunks appear with the corresponding speech
must.why: Chunks change over time (frame 3 shows 'Today I want to show you three easy', frame 4 'ways to make…'), so the full transcript is not shown at once.

must.item: Readable, inside frame, not covering face
must.why: White text with a black outline is readable, fully inside the frame and below her face. It sits over her torso and the top of her hands, not at the very bottom.

must.item: Original speech audible and framing preserved
must.why: The audio has sound at a peak of -0.6 dB, but the speech cannot be verified. The framing is preserved.

exact_text.read_as: No subtitle visible at 1 s while she is speaking; the greeting never appears in the sampled frames.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you three easy
'three easy' in one chunk, 'ways' starting the next chunk

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: ways to make your mornings less stressful. (the words are correct but 'ways' is attached)

faults.what: The opening greeting 'Hi everyone!' has no subtitle. The frame at 1 s shows her speaking with none on screen.
The subtitles sit at mid-lower frame over her torso and hands, not at the bottom. They stay clear of her face.
The phrase 'three easy ways' is split across two chunks.
The last chunk stays up from about 7 s to 9.5 s while she has finished speaking.

summary: The clip has readable white-with-black-outline subtitles that stay off her face and track the speech, but the opening 'Hi everyone!' appears to be missing, and the text sits mid-lower rather than at the bottom.
